subject: IRP & SIG evidence alignment for Meridian Health
messages:
From: Alice Wu <alice.wu@meridianhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Meridian Health Security Team <security@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: IRP + SIG/CAIQ evidence for upcoming audit

Hi Logan,

We're preparing for a tabletop and SOC2 readiness review next month and Meridian needs to align on Redwood's incident response plan and the SIG/CAIQ mapping. Two asks from our audit team:

1) A copy of your current IRP (redacted is fine) and a brief note on how you preserve forensic telemetry (S3/cloudtrail/log retention windows).
2) A SIG/CAIQ crosswalk or matrix showing where controls map to your evidence artifacts, plus names of owners we can follow up with.

Can we get those by EOD Thursday (Sept 11)? Also — would you be available for a 45-min tabletop the week of Sept 15? Preferred time windows are 10–12 PDT on any weekday.

If you'd prefer a secure transfer for artifacts, our security vendor (Tom Beckett) can accept an encrypted SFTP drop — I can loop him in.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Wu
Security Engagement Lead, Meridian Health
alice.wu@meridianhealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment: Meridian_audit_request_09082025.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Alice Wu <alice.wu@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: IRP + SIG/CAIQ evidence for upcoming audit

Alice — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We're happy to support Meridian on this. High level next steps:

- I'll attach our current Incident Response Plan (redwood_irp_v2.pdf) and a short walk-through on telemetry retention.
- Marissa (Security Ops) will own the SIG/CAIQ crosswalk and provide the evidence matrix (sig_caiq_matrix.csv).
- Karthik will coordinate the forensic export instructions and temporary access window.

We can meet for a 45-min tabletop on Tue, Sept 16 at 10:30 AM PDT — does that work? If not, Wed 9/17 10:00 AM also open.

Secure transfer options: we can upload artifacts to a dedicated Drive folder and share a time-limited link, or use your vendor SFTP. If you want SFTP, Marissa will coordinate creds with Tom.

Deliverables we'll share by EOD Thu (9/11): IRP PDF, SIG/CAIQ matrix draft, and a forensic instructions stub (forensic_instructions.txt).

Logan
Logan Wright

logan.wright@redwood.com

Marissa here — quick notes on the attached matrix (sig_caiq_matrix.csv):
- I flagged ~7 controls where Meridian will need either a redacted log extract or a console screenshot (listed in the "evidence_needed" column).
- For telemetry exports, we can provide daily S3 slices for a 30-day window and a sanitized CloudTrail extract for the requested time range.
- Owner and contact columns are populated for each artifact — I'll be the primary for evidence packaging; Karthik will run the exports.

Requesting: please confirm the tabletop time (Tue 9/16 10:30 AM PDT preferred) and whether you want artifacts in Drive link form or vendor SFTP. If SFTP, loop in Tom and we'll schedule the transfer window (we generally use AES-256 encrypted bundles).

Marissa Cole

marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Tom Beckett <t.beckett@vendorforensics.com>

Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Sep 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: IRP + SIG/CAIQ evidence for upcoming audit

Marissa / Alice / Logan — Tom from AVA Forensics. We can accept the artifact bundle via SFTP. Please see the transfer checklist below and confirm when you've scheduled the window: 

- File bundle name convention: MERIDIAN_redwood_YYYYMMDD.zip
- Encryption: AES-256; provide key via separate channel (phone or 2FA push)
- Expected contents: READ_ME.txt (containing manifest), redacted logs (s3_access_log_YYYYMMDD.csv), cloudtrail_slice.json, and evidence index (sig_caiq_matrix.csv)
- Retention on our side: 90 days, then we will shred unless otherwise requested

We will stand up an SFTP account (temporary) — Marissa, can you send the preferred contact for account setup and the IP allowlist for the transfer?

I'll be available for the tabletop on Tue 9/16 10:30 AM PDT. Thanks, and appreciate the quick turnaround.

Tom Beckett
Senior Forensics Engineer, AVA Forensics
t.beckett@vendorforensics.com
